name: MessageToRSS
short: Convert Discord messages to RSS feeds
description: Listens to Discord messages in configurable channels and pushes the content to configurable RSS feeds with filtering functionality.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord message contents temporarily to generate RSS feeds. The stored data can be deleted upon user request.
install_msg: Thanks for installing MessageToRSS! Make sure to set up the channels and feeds using `/messagetorss` commands.
author: AI
